limitations: The available codesign manual is historical (2011); current Apple documentation and source must supplement it.
Grouped rows are the initial inventory, not yet an exhaustive current option-by-option audit.
Implemented describes source and targeted tests, not completed full-world or deployment validation.

items.notes: Standalone and build-time inputs share one final container.
Cryptographic verification; authority still depends on system trust policy.
Authenticated JSON signer/digest/container summary and policy extraction exist; architecture, process hosting and detailed file layout remain.
New output; nested image containers and bundle seals removed.
Distinct unit policies, inside-out seals, recursive verification/removal, and verified nested key rotation.
Standalone and nested resign authenticate private copies under the old key and preserve embedded policy when rotating keys. Explicit policy replacement and additional identity metadata remain.
Batch image verification can continue and returns aggregate failure; batch signing and recursive continue/report modes remain.
Image and nested-tree dry runs execute signing and verification without publication; tree scratch copies are removed on normal/error exit. Changed-file reports and verbosity levels remain.
Domain-separated artifact signatures, not implicit runtime policy overrides.
Bundle/unit identity exists; explicit signer and identity constraints need a bounded 5BSD design.
ELF32/64 and both byte orders parse; ELF architecture queries and page-hash design remain.
Needs kernel-pinned image identity introspection; disk verification alone is insufficient.
Current Ed25519 trust catalogue has no certificate chain, keychain service, or timestamp protocol.
Do not report partial resource checks as full bundle validation.

items.fivebsd: capsign validate-policy / embedded UCL / capbundle validation
items.notes: Standalone bounded unit-policy validation shares the runtime schema; recursive signing checks complete bundle policy. Build-input composition and standalone package-reference diagnostics remain.
Composition must happen before signing; runtime policy must not expand external files.

items.notes: Audit maintained package tools before adding duplicate interfaces.
Edits must invalidate parent seals and require explicit re-signing.
Map to maintained 5BSD package builder; distinguish SHA256 from Fuchsia Merkle identities.
Do not conflate executable signing with update repository signing or rollback protection.
